# Shift AI Tech

> UK AI product company. We build, own, and operate AI products including BioSense, Braid, and Deep Space Learning.

Shift AI Tech (legal: Shift AI Technology Ltd, Companies House 17159725) is a founder-led AI product company based in Southminster, Essex, United Kingdom. We ship live AI products in health, compliance, and learning, and train models on NVIDIA DGX and cloud GPUs.

Disambiguation: not Shift Technology (insurance AI at shift-technology.com), not Shift AI at shiftai.co.uk (automotive dealer tools), not SHIFT AI LTD (Newcastle, 17222733), and not other unrelated "Shift AI" brands. Our domain is exclusively https://shiftaitech.com.

## Products

- BioSense: personal health intelligence from blood panels and wearables (bio-sense.ai)
- Braid: AI AML and risk assessments for regulated firms (usebraid.ai)
- Deep Space Learning: AI-avatar professional training courses
- Model training: NVIDIA DGX and cloud GPUs powering the product stack
